candidates.description: The percentage of viable tumor cells exhibiting partial or complete membrane staining for PD-L1, typically measured using the 22C3 assay.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the PD-L1 (22C3) result and extract the numerical percentage associated with the 'Tumor proportion score' or 'TPS'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Percentage (%) of tumor cells showing PD-L1 positivity.
candidates.name: PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Score (TPS)
candidates.uncertainty: It is unclear if other clones besides 22C3 were used in all cases, though 22C3 is explicitly mentioned in several reports.

citations.quote: EGFR wild‑type; aligns with prior testing on the original resection specimen.

candidates.description: The status of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) gene, specifically focusing on sensitizing mutations in exons 18-21.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Review the 'Molecular Testing' or 'Molecular Studies' section for EGFR. Assign 'Wild-type' if 'wild-type' or 'no sensitizing mutations detected' is stated. Assign 'Mutation detected' if a specific mutation (e.g., 'Exon 19 deletion') is identified.
candidates.measurement_definition: Binary classification based on PCR or NGS analysis: 'Wild-type' (no sensitizing mutations detected) or 'Mutation detected' (presence of activating mutations such as exon 19 deletion or L858R).
candidates.name: EGFR Mutation Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence includes both PCR-based and NGS-based testing; it is uncertain if these methods yield perfectly concordant results across all patients.

limitations: Sample size is small, consisting of a few individual pathology reports.
Some molecular data is pending in certain reports, leading to missing values for some candidates.
summary: The provided pathology and radiology reports for lung adenocarcinoma patients identify several measurable baseline variables, most notably PD-L1 expression levels and EGFR mutation status, which are standard predictors of therapeutic response in non-small cell lung cancer.
